verdict.rationale: The Apple M4 Max is a silicon chip with no user interface of its own, so API-versus-UI feature parity is a category error for this kind of product. Metal, MLX and PyTorch backends are developer frameworks that run on the chip; they are not an API that mirrors a UI, so they do not make this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
